title: R&W Unit 5: Careers of the Future
source: Henry's Gamma decks "M.3 R&W Unit 5 Lesson 1 and 4" (careers and work; future time clauses). American spelling.

questions.q: Which word means "a person or company that gives jobs to other people"?

Spell the word: "a long-term job or profession you develop over many years".

choices: I will apply for jobs after I graduate.
I will apply for jobs after I will graduate.
I apply for jobs after I will graduate.
I will applied for jobs after I graduate.

questions.q: "When I finish school, I will travel." The comma comes after the ___.
Fix the mistake: "When I will finish school, I will look for a job."
questions.answer: When I finish school, I will look for a job.

motions: Freelance work is better than working for one company.
A high salary is more important than a job you love.
Everyone should take a gap year before university.
Working from home is better than working in an office.
Robots will take most jobs in the future.
University is the best way to start a career.
Students should get work experience before they finish school.
It is better to have one career for life than many jobs.
Being reliable is more important than being clever at work.
Teenagers should have a part-time job.
